nodes.name: Create revision project
nodes.notes: Creates the project WITHOUT images (fast). Images are uploaded in batches by the next two nodes to stay under the serverless timeout.

nodes.name: Upload one image
nodes.notes: Runs once per input item (n8n's native per-item loop): uploads exactly ONE image as multipart/form-data binary (field 'images', from binary property 'data'). Sequential, no batching. After all images upload, flow continues to the Zoho/email delivery.
